---
title: "Subscribe"
comments: false
toc: false
---

I post every month or two: puzzles, intuitions, and the occasional simulation. If you would like an email when something new appears, leave your address below. You will get a note about new posts and nothing else, and every message carries a one-click unsubscribe link.

You will be asked to confirm the address before anything is sent, so check for a confirmation email after signing up.

```{=html}
<form class="subscribe-form" method="post" target="_blank"
      action="https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/fditraglia">
  <label for="bd-email">Email address</label>
  <input type="email" name="email" id="bd-email"
         placeholder="you@example.com" autocomplete="email" required>
  <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
</form>
```

If you would rather use a feed reader, there is an [RSS feed](/index.xml) covering every post, and a [second feed](/r-feed.xml) carrying only the posts that use R.
